Lior Beres A genuine tourist and visiting a family member are not the same thing

I am not giving advice to anyone nor suggesting to lie

If their daughter declared their parents details on her A5 visa application or at any other time then that is a different story

I am not even telling you about the law which I have studied

Everything can be analyzed and discussed on different levels

I am telling you how the system works

Those who understand will understand 

Plain and simple

And I am not saying there are not other reasons people are refused entry

For example:  If they do not have: a return ticket.
or travel insurance or cannot show they have sufficient funds for their stay or show evidence of their ties to Romania such as pensions, employment or property etc

And yes they do go according to the law and other regulations actually
